text:
maria_support: @chris_eng heads-up — customer acme-integration reports streaming JSON responses get truncated mid-object when their auth rotates. They see client-side JSON parse errors and a billing spike from automatic retries.
chris_eng: ack. do we have logs for their session id? which endpoint?
maria_support: route: /v1/generate/stream, session_id 0x7f9c. Happens intermittently when they rotate bearer token every 5m. Attached snippet from their client: 
```http
GET /v1/generate/stream?model=gpt-4x-stream HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <short-lived-token-A>
Accept: text/event-stream
```
maria_support: client receives SSE chunks, last chunk arrives `data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"..."}}` then connection closes. The final chunk is partial JSON (no closing braces). They retry and get multiple billing increments.
dan_infra: do we see upstream connection drop or 401 from auth service?
maria_support: customer pasted server side logs: 
```
2026-03-12T16:02:12Z INFO stream_conn opened session=0x7f9c token_id=tok-abc123
2026-03-12T16:07:02Z WARN auth token expired token_id=tok-abc123
2026-03-12T16:07:02Z ERROR stream_conn broken session=0x7f9c err=write tcp 10.2.1.5:443: connection reset by peer
```
chris_eng: looks like auth expiry happens mid-stream and upstream closes the socket. We should be returning an SSE final event or sending a well-formed EOF chunk, not just dropping connection. Otherwise client sees truncated JSON.
priya_billing: customer reports 4x token usage because they retry full request on parse error. Can we consider a customer-side advisory or a short-term credit?
dan_infra: quick repro plan: 1) issue short-lived token (30s) 2) start stream 3) rotate token server-side 4) observe connection behavior. I can repro locally.
chris_eng: thanks. assign to infra to confirm behavior across proxies (nginx LB vs envoy). Also check if gateway returns 401 mid-stream or closes without status.
maria_support: customer also sent curl stream dump: 
```
: ping
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"hello"}}]}

data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":" wor"}}]

# connection reset -- no final '}]}}'
```
chris_eng: that snippet suggests chunk boundary split inside JSON token. We have two issues: 1) abrupt close, 2) no graceful termination message.
dan_infra: possible fix paths: a) gateway should send a final SSE event like `data: __REDWOOD_STREAM_CLOSED__` with a reason code before closing, or b) accept token refresh without killing existing stream if token is tied to connection lifecycle. Need security review for b).
priya_billing: for impacted customer recommend: - temporary credit for retries - advise client to tolerate partial chunks and wait to confirm EOF marker before retrying - add small backoff + HEAD check before full retry
maria_support: customer asked if we can delay token expiry for active streams — they said rotating frequently is company policy.
chris_eng: we can't change token lifetime globally. We can: 1) in the short term, add docs snippet to recommend using refresh tokens to obtain a new stream token and reconnect gracefully, 2) implement server-side graceful close event ASAP.
deploy_bot: scheduled rollout window available tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC if we have PR.
chris_eng: dan, can you create a minimal PR to add a final SSE termination event on connection close with code EXPIRED_TOKEN or SOCKET_RESET? Keep it behind a feature flag. I'll review.
dan_infra: will do. repro shows nginx 1.22 closes upstream socket on 401 from auth-service. That path loses the final bytes. We need the gateway to intercept 401 and send termination event.
priya_billing: I'll open a support credit case for Acme and patch the billing spike while we roll the fix.
maria_support: customer appreciates quick attention. They want ETA on fix and KB they can share internally.
chris_eng: ETA: feature-flagged change -> QA -> deploy in next 48h if no blockers. I'll add a KB draft with suggested client retry pattern.
dan_infra: putting repro steps and nginx config I used in #eng-infra.
maria_support: thanks all. tagging @priya_billing when credit issued. Will post an interim customer-facing note. :thumbsup:
chris_eng: follow-ups: - confirm whether token rotation can be negotiated without stream tear-down (security check) - add termination event in gateway - KB + temporary billing credit
priya_billing: noted.
deploy_bot: deploy scheduled: 2026-03-14T02:00:00Z -> 2026-03-14T02:15:00Z (canary rollout).
maria_support: closing loop: customer invited us to their runbook call tomorrow 09:00 PST to review. I'll update thread with outcome.
